rules.statement: The Court has the power to enforce an order made under section 327(a) of the Civil Procedure Code, even if such an order is not a decree.
rules.supporting_quote: 'I find it impossible to subscribe to the view advanced by learned Counsel for the appellants that the Court having made an order under section 327 (a) is powerless to enforce that order if the persons against whom it was made persist in defying it.'
